id: title:Gilbert09:retry a transient s3 permission blip during table reset

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion and warehouse connector reliability, specifically handling transient credential resolution or permission errors.
review.reason: Adds a helper function `_is_retryable_purge_error` to distinguish transient object-store errors and bare PermissionError, removing previous checks. This could help PostHog avoid failing warehouse ingestion or warehouse connector due to transient credential resolution or permission errors.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the underlying credential resolution or the transient object store error detection, so the complete behavior of the transient credential race cannot be independently verified.
